mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_flow_notification_link_click (environment, access_token, notification_id, flow_execution_id, job_execution_id, actor_user_id, source, event_type, logged_in, event_at, client_ip, user_agent) VALUES (#{environment}, #{tokenHash}'', #{notificationId}, #{executionId}, #{jobExecutionId}, #{actorUserId}'', #{source}, #{eventType}, #{loggedIn}, toDateTime(#{eventAt,typeHandler=com.agentscopea2a.mapper.ck.typehandler.ClickHouseLocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, 'Asia/Shanghai'), #{clientIp}, #{userAgent})

INSERT INTO skill_flow_notification_link_click (environment, access_token, notification_id, flow_execution_id, job_execution_id, actor_user_id, source, event_type, logged_in, event_at, client_ip, user_agent, task_display_name, execution_at) SELECT e.environment, e.access_token, e.notification_id, e.flow_execution_id, e.job_execution_id, #{actorUserId}, e.source, 'LOGIN_VIEW', 1, toDateTime(#{eventAt,typeHandler=com.agentscopea2a.mapper.ck.typehandler.ClickHouseLocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, 'Asia/Shanghai'), e.client_ip, e.user_agent, e.task_display_name, e.execution_at FROM skill_flow_notification_link_click AS e WHERE e.environment = #{environment} AND e.access_token = #{accessToken} AND e.event_type = 'CLICK' AND e.actor_user_id = '' AND e.access_token NOT IN ( SELECT access_token FROM skill_flow_notification_link_click WHERE environment = #{environment} AND access_token = #{accessToken} AND event_type = 'LOGIN_VIEW' AND actor_user_id = #{actorUserId} ) ORDER BY e.event_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.sql:
SELECT flow_execution_id, job_execution_id, CASE WHEN flow_execution_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'LONG_TASK' ELSE 'INDEPENDENT_TASK' END AS execution_type, actor_user_id, source, event_type, max(logged_in) AS logged_in, coalesce(nullIf(any(task_display_name), ''), concat('任务 #', toString(ifNull(job_execution_id, flow_execution_id)))) AS task_display_name, toString(toTimeZone(any(e.execution_at), 'Asia/Shanghai')) AS execution_at, toString(toTimeZone(min(e.event_at), 'Asia/Shanghai')) AS first_event_at, toString(toTimeZone(max(e.event_at), 'Asia/Shanghai')) AS latest_event_at, count() AS event_count FROM skill_flow_notification_link_click AS e WHERE (#{filters.environment} IS NULL OR e.environment = #{filters.environment}) AND (#{filters.executionId} IS NULL OR e.flow_execution_id = #{filters.executionId} OR e.job_execution_id = #{filters.executionId}) AND (#{filters.source} IS NULL OR #{filters.source} = '' OR e.source = #{filters.source}) AND (#{filters.eventType} IS NULL OR #{filters.eventType} = '' OR e.event_type = #{filters.eventType})
AND e.event_at >= toDateTime(#{filters.from,typeHandler=com.agentscopea2a.mapper.ck.typehandler.ClickHouseLocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, 'Asia/Shanghai')
AND e.event_at < toDateTime(#{filters.to,typeHandler=com.agentscopea2a.mapper.ck.typehandler.ClickHouseLocalDateTimeTypeHandler}, 'Asia/Shanghai')
AND e.flow_execution_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.flow_execution_id, e.job_execution_id, e.actor_user_id, e.source, e.event_type
mapper.select:
ORDER BY latest_event_at DESC, flow_execution_id DESC, job_execution_id DESC, actor_user_id, source, event_type
LIMIT #{filters.limit} OFFSET #{filters.offset}
